body.statement: Yan--Wainwright's Gaussian approximation in Theorem~1 assumes all of condition \(4.4\), including condition \(4.4\mathrm{c}\).

source.locator: Theorem 1, first sentence, and condition (4.4c), p. 11 of arXiv:2401.13665v2
source.verbatim_statement: Under the sub-matrix condition (4.1), consider some δ > 0 for which the noise condition (4.3) and incoherence conditions (4.4) hold.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Theorem 1 on p. 11 of the arXiv PDF; condition (4.4c) is the final displayed component of condition (4.4) on that page.
